page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head above the text, with page number at the top right. Margin notes run down the right margin. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: cava: Extrinsecus vero convexa protu-berant, scapulas distendentia, ne in tho-racem concidant.
Clavicularum cum sunt capita, tum appendices.
Capita duo; Primum est depressius, quo cum Acromii summitate conjun-gitur.*
Alterum est rotundum, eaque parte sterni sinu recipitur.
Appendices utriq; parti assident suis obductæ cartilaginibus.
main_text.head: SECTIO VII. Septima sectio,DE HUMERO ET CUBITO.
main_text.p: Manuum ossa sunt cum Brachii, tum manus proprie dictæ.
Brachii,Brachium est totus ossium ductus à scapulis ad manum pertingens.
HumerusHumerus est maximum brachii os, te-res & longum, parte superiore cum scapulæ osse, inferiore cum cubito conjunctum.
Inferior pars ulnæ est, quæ levem radii sinum subiens, cum eo articulatur.

page.notes: The asterisk after "conjungitur" is a reference mark in the text, but no matching note is printed in the margin or below the text. Long s (s) has been transcribed as plain s throughout, so "ofsium" appears as "ossium", "afsident" as "assident", and "fuis" as "suis". The right margin notes are "Septima sectio," beside the section heading, "Brachii," beside the Brachium paragraph, and "Humerus" beside the Humerus paragraph; the notes are placed at the lines where they stand, with the section note placed inside the heading because headings are not paragraphs. The catchword "Radius" is set at the lower right below the last line. The page number is printed as "35ı", with the last digit a dotless i, read as 351.
